say:1:1033436001:1.text: Only if the Lucent Tree has a chance of recovering.
say:1:1033436001:1.source_cn: 不过这话都是建立在流荧树有望恢复原状的前提下。
say:1:1033436001:1.male: Only if the Lucent Tree has a chance of recovering.
say:1:1033436001:1.female: Only if the Lucent Tree has a chance of recovering.

say:2:1033436002:1.text: Otherwise, I can never atone for my sin, no matter how hard I work.
say:2:1033436002:1.source_cn: 要不然我就是工作到入土，也弥补不了所犯下的罪孽。
say:2:1033436002:1.male: Otherwise, I can never atone for my sin, no matter how hard I work.
say:2:1033436002:1.female: Otherwise, I can never atone for my sin, no matter how hard I work.

say:3:1033436003:1.text: Misarte above. The Lucent Tree has been purified, all thanks to the foreign mage, whoever he may be.
say:3:1033436003:1.source_cn: 弥萨忒保佑，流荧树终于得到了净化。感谢那位外来的魔法师...
say:3:1033436003:1.male: Misarte above. The Lucent Tree has been purified, all thanks to the foreign mage, whoever he may be.
say:3:1033436003:1.female: Misarte above. The Lucent Tree has been purified, all thanks to the foreign mage, whoever she may be.
